fusions.name: Unbudged Gore
fusions.desc: A lowered-crown butt that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 6% per tenth of your health already lost (max 30%).

fusions.name: Steady Hooves
fusions.desc: Stamps your footing, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 15% chance to leave each [Pinned] by roots for 1 second.

fusions.name: Will Not Be Moved
fusions.desc: Plant yourself and challenge up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles, pulling them onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Clinging to the Crag
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, your roots lock into the rock and you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
